title: 20-24-year-olds with a driver's license

source.name: Driver licensing rates by age
source.publisher: University of Michigan Transportation Research Institute (UMTRI), Sivak & Schoettle

notes: 20-24-year-old licensing fell from 91.8% (1983) to 76.7% (2014), then partly rebounded to 81.0% by 2021 -- unlike 16-year-olds, this age group is catching back up.
